diagnosis.original_evidence: In the real SetVertexShaderConstantFDest hook, any c64-touching write calls InvalidateGameWvpWrite; when UploadContainsOutRunWvp is false the original partial upload returns without RecordGameWvpWrite. Four successful partial c64 writes never create the raw source matrix demanded by R30 lens centre admission.
source_trace: Original EXE D3A5 and C993 direct centre ownership reaches the game shader constant hook.

Game D3D9 successful 1..3-register writes are aggregated only under exact source call, latched pose, shader epoch and device; a four-register source proof is then published into existing raw-game-WVP provenance.
R84 R30 and R33 use that proof for source-backed per-eye rendering when the spatial affine/depth checks pass; the host composes separately.
diagnosis.root_cause: The original-game WVP provenance capture only supports a single four-register-containing SetVertexShaderConstantF call; partial writes always invalidate source proof without reassembly.
alternatives_rejected: Do not infer source WVP from possibly head-injected live c64, broaden alpha lens classification to CABE halos, relax draw age 128 or bypass matrix depth/affine checks.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: New source-owner-restricted four-register staging records only successful direct C993 game uploads and resets on call/pose/shader/device changes, invalid owner, scene end, Present and Reset. The unchanged R30 source proof and spatial route consume the published complete matrix.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++17 constexpr regression static_assert covers positive 2+2 completion and rejects mixed call, pose, shader identity, shader epoch, device, non-centre source and reset. g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic smoke on staged helper passed.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only exact original-world WVP is captured; R84 R30 constructs two pose/FOV eye matrices from raw world-view while R33 requires physical left/right successful GPU draws and correct restoration.
